facts.claim: Install as app turns a Claude artifact into a Mac or Windows app; it is rolling out in beta.
facts.verbatim_support: The "Install as app" feature is rolling out in beta in Claude for Mac and Windows.

facts.claim: An installed app gets its own icon and opens in its own window instead of inside Claude.
facts.verbatim_support: it gets its own icon and opens in its own window instead of inside Claude

facts.claim: Each app can use Claude and your connectors and updates automatically when the artifact is edited.
facts.verbatim_support: Each app can use Claude and your connectors, and it updates automatically when the underlying artifact is edited.

facts.claim: Installed apps can send notifications or add items to the menu bar or system tray.
facts.verbatim_support: Installed apps can send notifications or add items to your menu bar or system tray.

facts.claim: There are three permission levels: Default, App permissions, Full computer access.
facts.verbatim_support: There are three levels of permissions:

facts.claim: Anthropic people made Linnet, a full layered image editor.
facts.verbatim_support: Linnet , a full layered image editor

facts.claim: Anthropic people made Tern, a terminal with Claude by your side.
facts.verbatim_support: Tern , a terminal with Claude by your side to help and explain

facts.claim: You need to be online and signed in to Claude to open an app.
facts.verbatim_support: You need to be online and signed in to Claude to open an app.
